title: RESEARCH: silent key drop when key table full during flash C_Login
description: flash_slot_populate_keys (src/wp11_pkcs11.c line ~638) silently stops adding keys if MAX_KEYS is reached: 'if (gi == MAX_KEYS) break; /* table full; silently stop */'. C_Login returns CKR_OK even if not all keys from the keystore were exposed. The caller has no way to detect the partial load. With MAX_KEYS=32 and WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_ENTRIES=64, a keystore with 20 keys on a system where the soft token already has 15 keys loaded would silently drop 3 keys. Research: determine whether this is reachable in typical deployments. Fix: flash_slot_populate_keys should return the number of keys dropped; C_Login should return CKR_DEVICE_MEMORY (or at minimum log a warning) if any keys were dropped. Add inline comment documenting the MAX_KEYS limit and the failure mode.
